name: Weborg Point Campground
note: Peninsula State Park's smallest campground: 12 electric sites in the woods at the base of Weborg Point, with a shower and flush-toilet building, an accessible fishing pier and a reservable enclosed shelter; no campground host. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: WI DNR Peninsula SP camping page (read 2026-11-17): 'Weborg Point campground ... 12 sites; all are electric and reservable' + DNR Weborg campground map (sites 100E-111E on two drive-in roads off Shore Road) -> drive-in RV campground at its own place, ~2.8 km from Tennison Bay (450), not a loop of another entry; public, no price gate
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-17: DNR Peninsula summer map + Weborg campground map: the 100E-111E loop sits at the base of Weborg Point on Green Bay (Lake Michigan), between Shore Road and the point's picnic area/shelter/fishing pier. Esri World Imagery (240 m leaf-off crop at 45.1348,-87.2398, rendered): the nearest pads on the north leg are ~40 m from the Green Bay beach but behind a continuous conifer band, so not bayfront; no official site photo confirms a view, so not bayview; an easy walk (tens of metres, park ground only, no road/town between) to Great Lakes shore = coastal walk, as at Tennison Bay 450.
flags: Fees not recorded: wisconsin.goingtocamp.com refuses (Azure 403, not tried) and no DNR page posts Weborg's rate; the park's other campgrounds read $28-53 base on GoingToCamp 2026-10-10 (all Weborg sites are electric, so likely the upper part).
Rig length unposted (GoingToCamp unread); agency silent -> keep. A 2017 Hipcamp review says 'Tennison Bay and Weborg are the best for longer units.'
Pin from DNR maps + imagery under canopy; the loop is not legible pad-by-pad on imagery, so pin is the loop centre between Shore Road and the point.
Season not published for Weborg (winter camping is Tennison Bay only); park dump station May-Oct. state:WI policy row supplies booking/entrance.
